title: 1998 Bleachers 23K Gold Kiss Psyco Circus Album Cover Prototype WCG Gem Mint 10
descriptionText:
This is a rare and unique item for any Kiss fan or collector of music memorabilia. The 1998 Bleachers 23K Gold Kiss Psyco Circus Album Cover Prototype WCG Gem Mint 10 is a one-of-a-kind piece that features the iconic rock band in a stunning and vibrant design.

With elements of music, art, and industry, this item is a must-have for any fan of Kiss or rock & pop. The original and authentic design is in excellent shape and has been well-preserved over the years. It's a great addition to any collection or as a special gift for a fellow Kiss fan.
